notes.title: CHUCHEL VS. Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30887835/9d2fabd81f8978c93516eb6ac2c53785b983de65.png[/img]

Hello.

You asked for it! Just one month after CHUCHEL launched on Steam we're bringing you some more good stuff to collect. 

[h1]Now you can make your Steam profile much prettier thanks to:[/h1]
[list]
[*]8 trading cards
[*]5 regular badges + 1 [i]super[/i] foil badge
[*]5 profile backgrounds inspired by in-game levels
[*]5 silly emoticons  ːchuchelangryː ːchuchelcrazyː ːchuchelsmileː ːchuchelwhyː ːchuchelwowː
[/list]
Who's going to be the first to snatch the foil badge and become SUPER-CHUCHEL?!

Have fun collecting and most importantly... Kindzabab!
